units.locator: Article 25.8. Specialist
units.text: 1) to examine materials of the administrative offence case relating to the subject matter of actions carried out with their participation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 25.8

units.locator: Article 25.8. Specialist
units.text: 2) with the permission of the judge, official or person presiding over the meeting of the collegial body handling the administrative offence case, to ask the person against whom proceedings are conducted, the victim and witnesses questions relating to the subject matter of those actions;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 25.8

units.locator: Article 25.8. Specialist
units.text: 3) to make statements and comments concerning the actions they perform. Those statements and comments shall be entered in the record.
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 25.8

units.locator: Article 25.8. Specialist
units.text: 5. For refusal or evasion of the duties provided for by part 2 of this Article, a specialist shall bear administrative liability under this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25.8

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: Article 25.9. Expert
units.label: Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.9. Expert
units.label: Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 1. Any adult with no interest in the outcome of the case and possessing specialised knowledge in science, technology, art or a craft sufficient to conduct an expert examination and give an expert opinion may be engaged as an expert.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 2. An expert shall:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 1) appear when summoned by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 2) give an objective opinion on the questions put to them and the explanations required in connection with the content of that opinion.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 3. An expert shall be warned of administrative liability for knowingly giving a false opinion.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 4. An expert may refuse to give an opinion if the questions put to them fall outside their specialised knowledge or if the materials provided are insufficient to give an opinion.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 5. An expert shall have the right:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 1) to examine materials of the administrative offence case relating to the subject matter of the expert examination and submit motions for additional materials necessary to give an opinion;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 2) with the permission of the judge, official or person presiding over the meeting of the collegial body handling the administrative offence case, to ask the person against whom proceedings are conducted, the victim and witnesses questions relating to the subject matter of the expert examination;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 3) to state in their opinion circumstances relevant to the case that were established during the expert examination and about which no questions were put to them.
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.9. Expert
units.text: 6. For refusal or evasion of the duties provided for by part 2 of this Article, an expert shall bear administrative liability under this Code.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 25.9

units.locator: Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.text: Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.label: Art. 25.10

units.locator: Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.label: Art. 25.10

units.locator: Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.text: 1. Any adult with no interest in the outcome of the case who knows the languages or has the sign-language interpreting skills (providing sign-language or deafblind interpreting) necessary for translation or sign-language interpreting during proceedings in an administrative offence case may be engaged as an interpreter.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.10

units.locator: Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.text: 2. An interpreter shall be appointed by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.10

units.locator: Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.text: 3. An interpreter shall appear when summoned by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case, carry out the assigned translation fully and accurately and certify its accuracy by their signature.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.10

units.locator: Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.text: 4. An interpreter shall be warned of administrative liability for knowingly providing an incorrect translation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.10

units.locator: Article 25.10. Interpreter
units.text: 5. For refusal or evasion of the duties provided for by part 3 of this Article, an interpreter shall bear administrative liability under this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25.10

units.locator: Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.text: Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.label: Art. 25.11

units.locator: Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.label: Art. 25.11

units.locator: Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.text: 1. A prosecutor shall, within their powers, have the right:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.11

units.locator: Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.text: 1) to initiate proceedings in an administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 25.11

units.locator: Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.text: 2) to participate in consideration of an administrative offence case, submit evidence and motions, and give opinions on matters arising during consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 25.11

units.locator: Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.text: 3) to lodge a protest against the ruling in an administrative offence case irrespective of participation in the case, and to perform other actions provided for by federal law.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 25.11

units.locator: Article 25.11. Prosecutor
units.text: 2. A prosecutor shall be notified of the place and time of consideration of an administrative offence case involving an offence committed by a minor and of an administrative offence case initiated by a prosecutor.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.11

units.locator: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 25.12

units.locator: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 25.12

units.locator: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Persons shall not be admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case as defence counsel or representatives if they are employees of bodies exercising state supervision and control or municipal control over compliance with the rules whose violation gave rise to the case, or if they previously participated in that case in another capacity.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.12

units.locator: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Persons shall not be admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case as specialists, experts or interpreters if they are related to the person being held administratively liable, the victim, their legal representatives, defence counsel, a representative, the prosecutor, the judge, a member of the collegial body or the official handling the case; if they previously participated in that case in another capacity; or if there are grounds to believe they have a direct or indirect personal interest in the outcome of the case.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.12

units.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
units.text: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
units.label: Art. 25.13

units.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
units.label: Art. 25.13

units.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
units.text: 1. Where the circumstances provided for by Article 25.12 of this Code precluding a person’s participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case as defence counsel, representative, specialist, expert or interpreter exist, that person shall be disqualified from participation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.13

units.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
units.text: 2. A declaration of self-recusal or an application for disqualification shall be submitted to the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.13

units.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
units.text: 3. After considering a declaration of self-recusal or an application for disqualification, the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case shall issue a procedural order granting or refusing it. If an application for disqualification is refused, the same person may not submit a repeated application for disqualification on the same grounds.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.13

units.locator: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness
units.text: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness
units.label: Art. 25.14

units.locator: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness
units.label: Art. 25.14

units.locator: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness
units.text: 1. A victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness shall, in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, be reimbursed for expenses incurred in connection with appearing before the court, body or official handling the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.14

units.locator: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness
units.text: 2. The work of specialists, experts and interpreters shall be remunerated in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.14

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 25.15

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 25.15

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be notified or summoned to appear before the judge, body or official handling the case by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt, a summons with acknowledgement of receipt, telegram, telephone message, fax or other means of communication that record the notification or summons and delivery of the notice to the addressee, including by text message or email (where the person consents to receive notices at the mobile phone number or email address they specify).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.15

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: A participant’s consent to notification by text message or email may be expressed in a separate statement specifying, in addition to the person’s details and consent to notification by those means, the mobile phone number or email address to which the notice is to be sent; or in an administrative offence record, another record provided for by this Code, a motion, complaint or protest, by specifying the participant’s mobile phone number or email address.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.15 · “A participant’s consent to notification by text message or…”

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. A notice addressed to an individual, including an individual entrepreneur or official, shall be sent to their place of residence. An individual entrepreneur’s place of residence shall be determined from information in the Unified State Register of Individual Entrepreneurs.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.15

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: A notice addressed to a legal entity shall be sent to its address. If the administrative offence was committed by a legal entity in the territory in which its branch or representative office operates, the notice shall be sent to the address of the legal entity or the address of the branch or representative office. The address of the legal entity, branch or representative office shall be determined from information in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.15 · “A notice addressed to a legal entity shall be sent to its…”

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. If defence counsel for the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, or a representative of the victim, participates in the proceedings, a notice addressed to that person or the victim may be served on (sent to) defence counsel or the representative.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.15

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. If a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case has requested that notices be sent to another address, the judge, body or official handling the case shall send the notice to that address.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.15

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. If a participant’s address or place of residence is unknown, sending the notice to the last known address or place of residence shall constitute due notification.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25.15

units.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6. Notices prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, may be sent to a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case in accordance with Article 24.9 of this Code. Where such a notice is sent, the participant shall be deemed to have received it in the cases specified in points 7 - 13 of part 6 of Article 24.9 of this Code.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 25.15

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 26.1

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 26.1

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: The following shall be established in an administrative offence case:
units.label: Art. 26.1 · “The following shall be established in an administrative offence…”

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) whether the event of an administrative offence occurred;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 26.1

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) the person who committed the unlawful action or omission for which this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation provides administrative liability;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 26.1

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) the person’s guilt in committing the administrative offence;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 26.1

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) circumstances mitigating administrative liability and circumstances aggravating administrative liability;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 26.1

units.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) the nature and amount of damage caused by the administrative offence;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 26.1
